# selfdoc layout

Inspect, check and migrate the per-repository directories selfdoc owns under .strictmetadata/

## layout dump

Print selfdoc's layout declaration: every directory it claims, whether the directory is handwritten or generated, whether the repository commits it, the manifest.toml that grants it and what that file must hold, and the paths it replaced

**Effect:** read_only

## layout validate

Check this repository's .strictmetadata/ directory: every directory carries a manifest.toml naming a tool this machine has, every directory selfdoc claims names selfdoc, a directory selfdoc owns starts with a dot exactly when it is generated, every directory selfdoc owns holds only what its side allows, nothing inside selfdoc's committed directories starts with a dot, every uncommitted directory selfdoc owns carries the .gitignore its declaration derives, and .strictmetadata/ holds directories and go.mod only

**Effect:** read_only

## layout migrate

Move this repository off a layout before this one: every directory whose manifest.toml names selfdoc under stricttools/ (the layout before this one, whose generated directories already start with a dot) or under .stricttools/ (the layout before that, which named every directory bare) moves under .strictmetadata/, a generated one behind a dot (stricttools/docs -> .strictmetadata/docs, stricttools/.docs-state -> .strictmetadata/.docs-state, stricttools/.docs-cache -> .strictmetadata/.docs-cache, stricttools/posts -> .strictmetadata/posts, stricttools/vocabulary -> .strictmetadata/vocabulary, .stricttools/docs -> .strictmetadata/docs, .stricttools/docs-state -> .strictmetadata/.docs-state, .stricttools/docs-cache -> .strictmetadata/.docs-cache, .stricttools/posts -> .strictmetadata/posts, .stricttools/vocabulary -> .strictmetadata/vocabulary). It creates .strictmetadata/ (the manifests naming selfdoc are the grant), writes each uncommitted directory's own .gitignore, removes selfdoc's block from the previous root's .gitignore (the file and the previous root go when nothing else is left), rewrites every selfdoc.json value naming a moved path and every generated root file's header, moves a CLAUDE.md an earlier selfdoc generated at the repository root to .claude/CLAUDE.md (where selfdoc generates it now, and Claude Code reads it), writes .strictmetadata/vocabulary/terms.toml empty when the project has none, converts the manifests (.strictmetadata/.docs-state/manifest.json and .strictmetadata/.docs-state/post-manifest.json) from schema_version 1 to 2, which records the project's accepted words and rejected patterns from .strictmetadata/vocabulary/terms.toml, and commits. In every repository it also converts the .strictmetadata/.gitignore an earlier selfdoc derived into one .gitignore per uncommitted directory, and moves strictcli's files out of every .strictcli/ directory into the .strictmetadata/ beside it: schema.json to .strictmetadata/.cli-schema/schema.json, test-coverage.json to .strictmetadata/.cli-test-coverage/manifest.json, and the coverage/ shards to .strictmetadata/.cli-test-coverage/shards/, writing each directory's manifest.toml naming strictcli and the .gitignore that keeps the shards out of the repository, deleting the stub go.mod, and removing the emptied .strictcli/ and an empty coverage/; for the repository root's .strictcli/ it also deletes .rlsbl/bases/.strictcli/go.mod, drops .strictcli/go.mod from .rlsbl/managed-files.json, and removes the root .gitignore's coverage/ line. A repository already on .strictmetadata/ whose manifests are on schema_version 1 gets the manifest conversion alone, and one whose .strictmetadata/vocabulary/ carries no manifest.toml -- a repository moved from the older .selfdoc/ layout -- also gets that directory's grant and .strictmetadata/vocabulary/terms.toml empty when the project has none, and one whose generated CLAUDE.md is still at its root gets that move. Another tool's directories stay where they are, and so does a hand-written CLAUDE.md. Refuses a repository already migrated with its manifests converted, its vocabulary directory granted, its ignore files converted, no .strictcli/ left, and no generated CLAUDE.md at its root; a .strictcli/ holding a file it does not know the place of, or one git does not track; a .strictcli/ file whose new place is taken; an .strictmetadata/.gitignore holding another tool's lines; part-way through a move; holding selfdoc's directories under both previous roots; never on a previous layout; holding .claude/CLAUDE.md beside a generated root CLAUDE.md; or ignoring .claude/CLAUDE.md in git. --dry-run prints the plan and changes nothing

**Effect:** mutating
